collections.title: Velvet Evenings
collections.description: Sculpted gowns and cocktail silhouettes in wine, midnight and plum. Corseted bodices, long slits and trains that move with the room.

collections.title: Bridal & Festive
collections.description: Heirloom-minded drapes and embellished lehengas, reworked with modern cuts, jewel tones and hand-finished detail.

collections.title: Garden Hours
collections.description: Soft pastels and fluid fabrics for long lunches and golden afternoons. Ruffles, florals and easy movement.

collections.title: City Edit
collections.description: Modern separates, minis and layers cut for everyday polish. Clean lines, rich colour and pieces that are easy to live in.

pairs.title: Chocolate Velvet Column
pairs.note: A strapless velvet column with a crystal-edged diagonal and a sweeping train.

pairs.title: Plum Lehenga & Wine Dupatta
pairs.note: Deep violet skirt with a gold-trimmed wine drape worn off the shoulder.

pairs.title: Ember Tunic & Flared Trousers
pairs.note: A tiered ember tunic over fuchsia flares, built for movement.

pairs.title: Rose Drape Set
pairs.note: A hand-embellished rose drape paired with a saturated fuchsia skirt.

pairs.title: Orchid Mermaid Gown
pairs.note: A sweetheart bodice melting into a feather-trimmed mermaid hem.

pairs.title: Sage Skirt & Rosebud Bodice
pairs.note: A fluid sage skirt with a floral-appliqué bodice.

process.title: Mood Board
process.description: Colour, texture and styling references that set the tone before a silhouette is locked.

process.title: Fashion Illustration
process.description: Croquis and concept drawings where proportion, drape and surface are resolved on paper.

process.title: Tech Pack
process.description: Development boards with fabric, trim, colour and accessory callouts for each look.

process.title: Pattern Making
process.description: Front and back working views used to clarify seams, volume and construction before cutting.
